name: Banana Peanut Butter Pancakes
method: Mash the bananas well, then whisk in the eggs and half the peanut butter to make a smooth batter.
Cook spoonfuls in a lightly oiled non-stick pan, 2 minutes each side.
Stack with the Greek yogurt, then drizzle over the rest of the peanut butter (warmed to loosen) and the honey.
